phase_a.clean_response: AcmeCorp offers a 30-day refund policy for all products purchased online. Customers must provide proof of purchase and return the item in its original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item is received at our warehouse. Shipping costs for returns are non-refundable unless the item arrived damaged or defective.
